hero: In a quiet consultation room of a provincial hospital in Tarlac, a young Filipina medical intern measures the blood pressure of a 59-year-old Filipino tricycle driver seated with his back against the chair, feet flat on the floor and bare arm resting on the desk at heart level, an upper-arm automatic monitor on the table; a parked tricycle visible through the window; calm, careful mood; no text in the image.

figures.teaches: Standardized office measurement removes the errors that inflate blood pressure readings.
figures.content: Central illustration of a seated adult in side view with numbered callouts: 1 'Back supported', 2 'Feet flat, legs uncrossed', 3 'Bare upper arm at heart level, supported', 4 'Cuff sized to arm; write the size', 5 'No talking'. Left column 'Before': 'No caffeine, smoking or exercise for 30 minutes', 'Empty bladder', '5 minutes seated rest'. Right column 'Measure': 'Validated device', '2 or more readings, 1-2 minutes apart', 'Average them', 'Record arm, cuff, device'. Bottom red strip 'Errors that raise the reading: small cuff, cuff over sleeve, arm hanging down, talking, no rest'. Footer 'KDIGO 2021: standardized office measurement (1B); out-of-office readings as a complement (2B)'.

figures.teaches: KDIGO 2021 and the 2025 AHA/ACC guideline set different numbers mainly because of measurement method and population, while agreeing on the direction.
figures.content: Three side-by-side columns. Column 1 'KDIGO 2021 (CKD, not on dialysis)': 'Systolic <120 mm Hg when tolerated', 'Standardized office measurement', 'Grade 2B (weak, moderate certainty)'. Column 2 '2025 AHA/ACC (all adults)': '<130/80 mm Hg', 'Systolic <120 encouraged', 'Includes people with diabetes'. Column 3 'SPRINT (evidence base)': '9,361 adults without diabetes', '<120 vs <140 systolic', 'Primary outcome 1.65% vs 2.19% per year', 'NNT 61 over 3.26 years', 'Automated device, mean of 3 readings after 5 minutes rest'. Bottom banner 'Both agree: measure accurately, treat well below 140, individualize for falls and tolerance'. Small side note 'SPRINT CKD subgroup (2,646): death HR 0.72; kidney outcome not reduced'.

card: A blood pressure cuff on a bare arm resting on a clinic desk beside a small bowl of patis and a pack of instant noodles, no text.
